header: Spot bookings or a fixed weekly slot
subheadline: Both options use the same network. They differ in what you pay in week 46 and in whether your trailer space is reserved when plans change.
left_description: You call the depot when a load is ready and take the space that is free that day. Rates follow the market: a Vienna to Rotterdam pallet costs EUR 96 in February and up to EUR 174 in peak weeks.

left_points.text: Rate quoted per load, valid 48 hours
Space not guaranteed in peak weeks
Booking cut-off at 14:00 the day before

right_description: A reserved trailer space on a scheduled departure, with the price fixed for 12 months. Vienna to Rotterdam costs EUR 118 per euro pallet, and the slot is yours in week 7 and in week 46.

right_points.text: EUR 118 per euro pallet, fixed for 12 months
Trailer space reserved on every departure
Booking cut-off at 18:00 on departure day
Live tracking in the shipper portal
A named depot contact and a 24/7 escalation line
